description: Public holidays and business days (New Zealand) [NZ]. Lists New Zealand public holidays and regional anniversary days for 2026 and 2027, checks whether a date is a business day, adds or subtracts business days, and counts business days between two dates (Monday to Friday, excluding public holidays). Mondayised holidays count by default; pass includeMondayised false for people who work weekends. Only 2026 and 2027 are supported; other years return an error.

days.description: add_business_days: whole business days to add (negative to go back)

extraHolidays.description: Extra non-working dates, e.g. a shutdown

includeMondayised.description: NZ: count Mondayised holidays; default true

includeRegional.description: AU: count regional holidays such as show days; default false

mode.description: list: public holidays in a year; is_business_day: is a date a working day; add_business_days: move a date forward or back by business days; business_days_between: count business days after start up to and including end

region.description: Optional NZ anniversary region to include its anniversary day

name: nz_public_holidays
